profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Full-Stack web developer specialized on Front-End development with over 6 years of experience. 

I have worked with companies from Mexico and France, I have been part of different teams where we built projects for government, important companies, and startups.
Also built, tested, and deployed a page for an important cleaning company in Mexico as freelancer.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: SCSS · Angular · JavaScript · C# · ASP.NET MVC · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET Core · .NET Framework · ASP.NET Razor · Entity Framework (EF) Core

positions.title: Full-Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Creation of a web platform that shows information about the company and their product.

Back-End
     -The API was created using Visual Studio as IDE, working with C#, ASP.netcore and Entity Framework. Working with 3 layers, that allow us to separate the http communication, logic and DB communication.
     -Working with custom middlewares, custom filters, custom validation attributes and more.
     -MySQL as DBMS using triggers and stored procedures to help us to handle some data.

Front-End
     -The project was created with Angular Framework with no libraries included.
     -Use of HTML, SASS (css preprocessor), JavaScript, TypeScript.
     -We created all the components as modules for better performance so the components can be lazy loaded and also allow us to encapsulate and reuse the components.

Others
    -Use of Git as version control.
    -SCRUM as agile methodology using Jira
positions.insights: Skills: SCSS · Angular · JavaScript · C# · MySQL · .NET Core · Entity Framework (EF) Core

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
I participated in different projects from landing pages to big web apps like e-commerce and administration platforms; One of those projects was for government.

When the projects were simple, we chose also a simple way to build them, for instance just using HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript. But some projects required a more robust, scalable and easy maintainable technology. That is where Angular or React comes to help to resolve the problem.

We used some other JS libraries to do a fast coding.

Programming Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript.
Framework: Angular
Libraries: React, Bootstrap, GSAP, Material Design and more.
Technologies / Languages: HTML, CSS / SASS.
Version control: GIT and Bitbucket.
Agile methodology: SCRUM.

Other basic knowledge
  -Adobe XD
  -Adobe Photoshop
  -Adobe After Effects.
